_note: Curated inputs for report.py. Every item carries a source and a confidence flag. 'verify' means the figure came from secondary knowledge and must be checked against the cited source before publication. Edit this file to update figures; no code changes needed.

benchmarks._source: GDG Providence AI Lab for Housing materials; RIPEC (2026). Hard-cost share, escalation, and pass-through are planning assumptions.

funding_sources.name: 2024 Housing & Community Opportunity Bond (Question 3)
funding_sources.use: Production, preservation, homeownership, site acquisition, community revitalization

funding_sources.name: ARPA State Fiscal Recovery Fund housing allocation
funding_sources.use: Development subsidies, site acquisition, homelessness, down-payment assistance (obligation deadline Dec 2024)

funding_sources.name: Housing Production Fund (HPF)
funding_sources.use: Flexible gap financing; partly funded by the real estate conveyance tax on high-value sales (2023 change)

funding_sources.name: Federal 9% / 4% LIHTC
funding_sources.use: Equity for rental production; state ceiling set per capita, allocated through RIHousing's QAP

funding_sources.name: HOME and National Housing Trust Fund
funding_sources.use: Gap financing; HTF reserved for ≤30% AMI units

funding_sources.name: State operating budget: Department of Housing / Housing Resources
funding_sources.use: Annual appropriation; fill in from the enacted budget or run with --ai to look it up

laws.name: Low and Moderate Income Housing Act (R.I. Gen. Laws ch. 45-53)
laws.mechanism: Single comprehensive permit from the local review board for projects with ≥25% LMI units; 10% affordability goal per municipality; appeals to State Housing Appeals Board.
laws.impact: Main entitlement path for subsidized housing; its timeline sets carry cost.

laws.name: Affordable housing property tax assessment (R.I. Gen. Laws §44-5-13.11)
laws.mechanism: Qualifying restricted rental property is assessed at 8% of prior-year gross scheduled rental income instead of market value.
laws.impact: Lowers operating expense and raises NOI and debt capacity for nonprofit owners.

laws.name: Federal LIHTC (IRC §42) and 2025 federal tax law changes
laws.mechanism: Credit ceiling per capita; 2025 law permanently raised 9% allocations ~12% and lowered the 4% bond-financing test from 50% to 25% for bonds issued after 2025.
laws.impact: More 4% deals can close with less volume cap; the gap per deal still needs state soft funds.

laws.name: Source-of-income anti-discrimination (2021 amendment to RI Fair Housing Practices Act)
laws.mechanism: Landlords may not refuse tenants because they pay with vouchers or other lawful income.
laws.impact: Wider voucher use stabilizes rent collection for ELI units.

laws.name: Adaptive reuse of commercial buildings (2023 housing package)
laws.mechanism: By-right residential conversion of qualifying commercial structures with density and parking relief.
laws.impact: Shortens entitlement; check whether surplus schools and other institutional buildings qualify.

laws.name: Accessory dwelling units by right (2024 housing package)
laws.mechanism: ADUs permitted by right on qualifying lots, subject to local standards.
laws.impact: Small-scale supply with no subsidy needed.

laws.name: Federal cross-cutting requirements on HOME/HTF (Davis-Bacon, NEPA, Section 3)
laws.mechanism: Prevailing wages at 12+ HOME-assisted units; environmental review before choice-limiting actions.
laws.impact: Raises hard cost and adds months; it is a common reason a layer adds ~4 months.

laws.name: LIHTC extended use and qualified contract option
laws.mechanism: 15-year compliance plus extended use (≥30 years total); the qualified contract option can let an owner exit after year 15.
laws.impact: Expiring restrictions reduce affordable supply unless recapitalized.

laws.name: Annual Consolidated Funding RFP cadence (RIHousing practice, not statute)
laws.mechanism: Most state soft funds awarded once a year alongside 9% LIHTC.
laws.impact: Projects that are ready mid-cycle wait ~6 months on average; projects that are declined wait 12+.

Eliminate parking minimums near transit; by-right +30% density; unified review
Ground-lease surplus schools at nominal rent with a comprehensive permit pre-approved
Extend 8%-of-rent assessment to non-LIHTC deed-restricted units (e.g., HPF-only, 80–100% AMI)
Fund a state ELI operating subsidy paired with HTF/HPF capital awards
Use the 25% bond test to push more 4% + state-LIHTC deals through each round
